headline: Sosa's grand slam caps ninth-inning rally past Angels
recap: The Phillies trailed 3-0 early Friday night at Angel Stadium before Derek Hill's RBI single in the fifth inning cut the deficit to 3-1. Philadelphia broke through in the ninth, when Edmundo Sosa delivered a pinch-hit grand slam that turned a two-run deficit into a 5-3 lead. Andrew Painter started and allowed three runs over six innings with six strikeouts. Jose Alvarado followed with a scoreless seventh and Alex McFarlane a scoreless eighth to pick up the win, and Jonathan Bowlan closed it out for his second save.
The win pushed Philadelphia to 75-60, holding second place in the NL East, five games behind the division-leading Atlanta Braves, and extending their winning streak to two games.
The Phillies continue their series at the Angels tonight, with first pitch at Angel Stadium set for 10:07 PM ET. Cristopher Sanchez starts for Philadelphia opposite Angels right-hander Ryan Johnson.
